title: Clean up stale dashboard feature scaffolding: unpopulated barrel + redundant .gitkeep files

evidence.quote: // Populated in Wave 5 (W5.x) — dashboard domain and UI cleanup.

why: dashboard.dart claims to be 'Populated in Wave 5' and to be the required cross-feature entry point, but exports nothing — confirmed by repo-wide grep, nothing imports it, so today it's a documentation claim rather than an enforced boundary. Separately, four .gitkeep placeholders (domain/use_cases, presentation/providers, presentation/screens, presentation/widgets) exist purely to keep an empty directory tracked in git, but each of those directories has held real source files since the feature was built out (presentation/widgets alone now has 20 real files) — the placeholders are leftover noise in every directory listing.
recommendation: Either populate dashboard.dart's exports (if/when another feature needs the barrel) or delete it and remove the header comment's claim; git rm the four stale .gitkeep files in now-nonempty directories.
acceptance_criteria: find lib/features/dashboard -name .gitkeep only matches directories that ls shows as otherwise empty.
dashboard.dart either has at least one export or is deleted.
